name: Upspring
description: Ad intelligence by domain: an advertiser's live ads plus coarse modelled spend, traffic and sales grades (D to A+), creative signals and a strategy read.

methods.label: Get Advertiser by Domain
methods.description: Resolve one advertiser from a website domain (bare domain or full URL, normalized to the root). Returns { data } with id, name, vertical, category, summary, enrichment { spend, traffic, sales } (each { grade: D|C|B|A|A+, floor, estimated, note }), social { fb_followers, ig_followers, active_ads, as_of }, signals (personas, mechanisms, hooks, media_mix, funnel), hook_themes, top_ads [{ id, one_line, media_type, is_active }] and status. Never 404s: status is 'ready', 'pending' (call again after refetch_after seconds, or pass sync=true to wait briefly) or 'unavailable' (data is then just { domain, status }). Grades are coarse estimates, never exact figures.

domain.description: Website domain, e.g. 'takeultra.com' (a full URL is also accepted and normalized to the root)

sync.description: Wait briefly (capped) for a 'pending' advertiser to become ready and return it in one response. Falls back to 'pending' if it does not settle in time.

methods.label: Get Advertiser
methods.description: Get one advertiser's brief by Upspring advertiser id (from getAdvertiserByDomain or listAdvertisers). Same shape as getAdvertiserByDomain: profile, spend/traffic/sales grade enrichment, social, reddit summary, creative signals, hook themes and top ads, with status 'pending' | 'ready' | 'unavailable'.

methods.label: List Advertisers
methods.description: List or filter advertisers. Returns { data[], meta } where each item has id, name, domain, vertical, category, subcategories, dominant, geo, active_ads and enrichment (spend/traffic/sales grades). spend_tier, traffic_tier and sales_tier are open floors (D <= C <= B <= A <= A+): 'B' returns advertisers graded B or higher. Page with meta.next_cursor.

domain.description: Website domain, URL or partial term

fb_page.description: Facebook page URL or numeric page id

spend_tier.description: Minimum spend grade: D | C | B | A | A+

traffic_tier.description: Minimum traffic grade: D | C | B | A | A+

sales_tier.description: Minimum sales grade: D | C | B | A | A+

methods.label: List Ads
methods.description: List or search ads. Returns { data[], meta } where each ad has id, advertiser, media_type, is_active, started_at, dimensions, one_line, hook_text, strength and ad_library_url. Pass advertiser_id (from getAdvertiserByDomain) with is_active=true to get an advertiser's live ads. Use q for keyword search. order_by is random (default) | recent | best. Page with meta.next_cursor.

is_active.description: true = currently running ads only, false = stopped ads only, omit for both

recency_days.description: Only ads first seen in the last N days
